verdict.rationale: USCIS is a government immigration agency. Its core product is official adjudication of applications, petitions and case status, which by its nature cannot be self-hosted by a user. Self-hosting is therefore a category error for this kind of product, not a missing capability. The evidence describes only hosted myUSCIS accounts and the hosted Torch APIs, with no self-hostable distribution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
